# Journalism AI v3.0.7

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on AI.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.7/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [askAI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.7/docs/functions/askAI.md): askAI function
- [askAIPool](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.7/docs/functions/askAIPool.md): askAIPool function
- [getEmbedding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.7/docs/functions/getEmbedding.md): getEmbedding function
- [getEmbeddingIdentity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.7/docs/functions/getEmbeddingIdentity.md): getEmbeddingIdentity function
